evals.name: route-exposure-audit
evals.prompt: Přebírám cizí Laravel 11 appku (interní ERP, spatie permission). Potřebuju rychle zjistit, které zápisové routy jsou dostupné bez přihlášení nebo jen s auth bez oprávnění, a pohlídat to do budoucna v CI.
evals.expected_output: route:list --json + jq filters, warning about routes after the auth group and withoutMiddleware, RouteSecurityTest using gatherRouteMiddleware with public allowlist and baseline ratchet.
expectations: Uses php artisan route:list --json (or gatherRouteMiddleware) to resolve middleware
Checks both authentication and authorization (permission/can) on POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE
Mentions withoutMiddleware on groups as a hole
Provides a PHPUnit test that fails on new unprotected write routes
Flags GET routes with side effects

evals.name: shoptet-webhook-signature
evals.prompt: We receive Shoptet webhooks in Laravel (order:delete, customer:delete...) and currently just trust them. How do I verify them properly and make the delete handling safe?
evals.expected_output: Middleware computing hash_hmac('sha1', raw body, signatureKey) compared with Shoptet-Webhook-Signature via hash_equals, per-eshop key from renew-signature-key, IP range as defense in depth, dedup + queue + fast 200, re-fetch before delete.
expectations: Uses HMAC SHA1 over the raw request body with the per-eshop signatureKey
Compares with hash_equals and fails closed
Re-fetches from Shoptet API before deleting locally
Validates/encodes eventInstance before using it in API URLs

evals.name: wizard-and-decision-links
evals.prompt: Máme veřejného průvodce reklamací (číslo objednávky + e-mail) a v e-mailech odkazy 'zrušit objednávku' s tokenem. Projdi, na co si dát pozor a jak to napsat bezpečně v Laravelu 12.
evals.expected_output: Session stores order_id only after verification, later steps use find(session id), throttle + uniform errors, bounded quantities, state guards; links via temporarySignedRoute or hashed token + hash_equals, expiry, single use, POST confirmation, no hardcoded bypass.
expectations: Stores the verified order ID in session only after full verification
Recommends temporarySignedRoute or hashed token with hash_equals, expiry and single use
Warns against GET performing the state change (link prefetch)
